fields.value: A Fortitude Valley Dental Practice Built on Trust

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Precision Dental began with a simple idea: that visiting the dentist should feel reassuring, not intimidating. Our principal dentist, Dr Billy Choi, spent many years providing dental care across Brisbane before establishing a practice of his own alongside a team of like-minded professionals. Today, we care for patients from Fortitude Valley and the surrounding inner-city suburbs, as well as families who travel from further across Brisbane.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: We are a general and cosmetic dental practice, which means we can look after most of your family's dental needs under one roof. From a child's first check-up to restoring a worn smile, our focus remains the same: listen carefully, explain clearly and provide considered care.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Three principles shape the way we work, and they guide every conversation, every treatment plan and every appointment.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: No shortcuts, no surprises and no compromise on materials. A trusting relationship between patient and dentist is the foundation of successful care, and it starts with honest, balanced information. We show you what we see, explain your options, including the option to wait or monitor, and discuss expected costs before any treatment begins.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We understand that many people carry uneasy memories of past dental visits, or simply dislike the feeling of instruments in their mouth. Our team takes the time to put you at ease. We work gently, check in with you throughout, and offer extras such as noise-cancelling headphones, ceiling-mounted televisions, memory-foam chairs and happy gas. Our anxious patients are always welcome to take things one step at a time.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: You are an individual, and your dental care should reflect that. We take time to reach an accurate diagnosis, plan carefully, use quality materials and keep you informed at every stage.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Behind every appointment is a close-knit team of clinicians and support staff who genuinely care about your experience. You can read more about Dr Billy Choi or meet our team, including our oral health therapist, coordinators and dental assistants.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Precision Dental is an accredited practice, independently assessed against the National Safety and Quality Health Service Standards. We follow strict infection prevention and control protocols, including thorough decontamination of treatment areas between patients and sterilisation of reusable instruments.

fields.label: Photo description (alt text)

sections.template:

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our dental technology includes an intra-oral camera, digital X-rays, a digital OPG, DiagnoCam imaging, a 3D intra-oral scanner and CEREC for same-day restorations. These tools help us diagnose accurately, plan precisely and, just as importantly, show you exactly what we are seeing.

fields.label: Photo description (alt text)
fields.value: Dentist showing a patient their intra-oral scan on screen

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We believe you should understand the cost of your care before you commit to it. You can explore our Prices and Payment Options, including HICAPS claiming, preferred provider arrangements and interest-free payment plans through DentiCare.
